mapper.select:
SELECT io.id FROM lm_inspection_order io WHERE io.is_deleted = 0
AND io.id IN
#{oid}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lm_task t1 WHERE t1.inspection_order_id = io.id AND t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t1.is_executable = 1 AND (t1.status IS NULL OR t1.status != 'REVIEW_PASSED') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lm_inspection_scheme_parameter isp WHERE isp.version_id = io.scheme_version_id AND isp.is_deleted = 0 AND isp.is_executable = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lm_task t2 WHERE t2.inspection_order_id = io.id AND t2.parameter_id = isp.parameter_id AND t2.is_deleted = 0 AND t2.is_executable = 1 ) )

SELECT io.*, COALESCE(s.name, ss.name) as scheme_name, COALESCE(sv.version_no, ssv.version_no) as scheme_version, m.name as material_name, m.code as material_code, m.category_id, m.unit_id, m.specification as material_spec, dc.name as template_name, io.create_by as request_user_id, COALESCE(io.finished_time, io.terminate_time) AS orderEndTime, io.create_time as request_time FROM lm_inspection_order io LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_version sv ON io.scheme_version_id = sv.id AND io.scheme_source = 'REGULAR' LEFT JOIN lm_stability_scheme_version ssv ON io.scheme_version_id = ssv.id AND io.scheme_source = 'STABILITY' LEFT JOIN lm_document_config dc ON io.template_id = dc.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_scheme s ON sv.scheme_id = s.id LEFT JOIN lm_stability_scheme ss ON ssv.scheme_id = ss.id WHERE io.id = #{id} AND io.is_deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT io.id, io.order_no AS orderNo, io.material_id AS materialId, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, io.batch_no AS batchNo, io.create_time AS createTime, io.create_by AS createBy, io.create_time as request_time, io.create_by AS request_user_id, io.remark FROM lm_inspection_order io LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id WHERE io.is_deleted = 0 AND io.order_status != 'PENDING_CONFIRM' AND io.order_status != 'TERMINATED' AND io.order_status != 'COMPLETED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lm_sample s WHERE s.inspection_order_id = io.id AND s.received = 1 AND s.discarded = 0 AND s.is_deleted = 0 )
AND io.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.orderNo}, '%')
AND m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.materialName}, '%')
AND m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.materialCode}, '%')
AND io.material_id IN
#{mid}
AND io.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.batchNo}, '%')
AND io.create_time >= #{query.inspectionRequestTimeStart}
AND io.create_time <= #{query.inspectionRequestTimeEnd}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lm_sample s2 WHERE s2.inspection_order_id = io.id AND s2.sample_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.sampleNo}, '%') AND s2.is_deleted = 0 )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lm_sample s3 WHERE s3.inspection_order_id = io.id AND s3.sample_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.sampleName}, '%') AND s3.is_deleted = 0 )
ORDER BY io.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT io.id) FROM lm_inspection_order io WHERE io.is_deleted = 0 AND io.order_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND (io.scheme_source IS NULL OR io.scheme_source != 'STABILITY') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lm_sample s0 WHERE s0.inspection_order_id = io.id AND s0.sampled = 0 AND s0.discarded = 0 AND s0.is_deleted = 0 )
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM lm_inspection_order io WHERE io.is_deleted = 0 AND io.template_id = #{templateId}

SELECT io.id, io.order_no, io.batch_no, io.order_status, io.finished, io.finished_time, io.create_by AS request_user_id, io.create_time AS request_time, s.name AS scheme_name, sv.version_no AS scheme_version, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lm_sample ls WHERE ls.inspection_order_id = io.id AND ls.sampled = 1 AND ls.is_deleted = 0 ) AS has_sampled FROM lm_inspection_order io LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_version sv ON io.scheme_version_id = sv.id AND sv.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_scheme s ON sv.scheme_id = s.id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE io.is_deleted = 0 AND io.batch_no = #{batchNo} AND io.material_id = #{materialId} AND io.scheme_source = 'REGULAR' AND io.order_status != 'TERMINATED' ORDER BY io.create_time DESC
